verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a drop-in OpenAI-compatible API at localhost:8080, Anthropic Messages API support for Claude clients, and OpenAI functions/tools calling with an autoparser for tool-trained models. Together these cover the protocol and tool-use requirements for pointing a coding agent at it as a backend. missing for 10: a documented setup guide for a named coding agent (e.g. a specific CLI/IDE agent), independent or hands-on corroboration that agentic tool-call loops work reliably, and per-model tool-calling quality guidance.
